sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000172-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Harborview Regional Hospital 172 on January 15, 2026.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 3.25%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 670 Influenza doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: countered by the Customer.
